name: Proofreader's Redline
summary: Metrics set like a galley proof; Pulse strikes the wrong figure with a coral pen, writes the right one and a human initials it.
look: A warm white galley page with slug line, line numbers and a ruled margin; Instrument Serif body with mono figures. Coral pen marks (strike, circle, underline, margin notes) sit on top, and a teal boxed sign-off closes each decision.

components.name: Galley page
components.role: slug line, line numbers, ruled left margin, serif type

components.name: Strike & replace
components.role: jittered coral line through the wrong figure, correction written above

components.name: Circle
components.role: loose hand-drawn loop around one word or action; max three marks per shot

components.name: Margin note
components.role: italic coral annotation with a thin leader line

components.name: Human initials
components.role: teal boxed sign-off that closes the decision

motion.name: Pen stroke
motion.how: stroke-dashoffset with slight speed variance, power2.out, 250–500 ms per mark, each starting on a beat at 120 BPM

motion.name: Value swap
motion.how: wrong figure dims to 30% while the correction masks up from below in 200 ms, landing on the downbeat

motion.name: Margin pull
motion.how: leader draws in 180 ms, note fades in with a 1° rotation settle (back.out, 300 ms)

story: Hook: 'How many dashboards did you check today?' — the pen strikes 'check', writes 'open', notes '38 open, 3 read', and circles 'Friday.' with 'found by a customer'. Reveal: 'Acme Pulse' sets in one hit under the mark, the pen double-underlines 'Pulse', 'stet — keep it big', teal 'approved'. Proof: a morning-metrics table sets row by row; the pen strikes checkout '3.1 %', writes '2.5 %', margin note '−18% since 09:42, after deploy #2231'; the human circles 'Roll back' and initials 'OK — on-call, 09:48'. CTA: 'Caught before customers noticed.' with 'before' circled, lockup, an arrow to the coral Start free button.
adapt: Typeset your own table (orders, test results, KPIs, contract terms) and let the pen correct exactly one figure; the initials box is where your approve / reject action lives.

fit.risk: too many marks become chaos; cap at three per shot and keep the page mostly clean
